Package io.parsley

package io.parsley
Parsley: causal consistency for Kafka. A single package whose public surface is interfaces and records; all implementations are package-private and obtained through factory methods.

Entry points (interfaces with static factories)

  • CausalProcessorSupplier — CausalProcessors.builder(...).build() wraps your own Kafka Streams Processor so its state access and forwards run behind the causal guarantee; drop it into stream(...).process(...)
  • CausalConsumer — CausalConsumers.builder(...).build() delivers records in causal order over a poll() API
  • CausalProducer — CausalProducers.builder(...).build() stamps the causal dependencies onto produced records

Key value types

  • CausalBuffer — registers one causal source on a builder: a topic name paired with the serdes the buffer round-trips held records with (the topic's stable UUID is resolved from the broker automatically)
  • CausalDependencies — the causal requirements stamped on a record (what the consumer must have observed before the record may be delivered); build one from the CausalTopic identities you register, or read a consumed record's dependencies with fromRecord when propagating across services. Its serialised size grows with the number of relevant topic-partitions and counts against Kafka's message.max.bytes
  • CausalTopic — a topic's stable causal identity (name + Kafka UUID), used when declaring CausalDependencies
  • CausalBufferLimit — how long to wait for a record's dependencies before forwarding it anyway: ofDuration, ofSize, or first

    Description
    CausalBuffer<K,V>
    Registers one causal source: a topic name paired with the serdes Parsley's buffer uses to (de)serialise records held from that topic.

    Defines when records held in a causal buffer should be evicted.
    CausalConsumer<K,V>
    A high-level Kafka consumer that delivers records in causal order.

    Factory for CausalConsumer.
    CausalConsumers.Builder<K,V>
    Builder for a CausalConsumer.
    CausalDependencies

    CausalDependencies.Builder
    Builder for CausalDependencies.
    CausalProcessors
    Factory for CausalProcessorSupplier — the decorating causal processor you drop into a Kafka Streams topology with stream(...).process(...).

    Builder for a CausalProcessorSupplier.
    CausalProcessorSupplier<KIn,VIn,KOut,VOut>

    Factory for CausalProducer.

    Builder for a CausalProducer.
